{{Quote|It's not really about the glory, the holo-dramas, or even the rewards. I mean, those are all good, but can't keep putting it all on the line unless you love the hunt itself.|Viktor Hel|<ref name="ND" />}}
'''Viktor Hel''' was a famous [[Corellian/Legends|Corellian]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] living during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. He piloted a [[Color/Legends|green]] [[Kihraxz assault fighter]] as his personal starship and owned [[Hel's Outfitting]], a small store in [[Winterdome]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Corfai]].<ref name="Suns of Fortune">''[[Suns of Fortune]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:Viktor_Hel_Kihraxz_Fighter_XWM.png|thumb|left|200px|Hel's personal Kihrxz fighter evading police gunships.]]
Viktor Hel first appeared in an introductory short story in the [[Fantasy Flight Games]] sourcebook [[No Disintegrations (Fantasy Flight Games)|''No Disintegrations'']] for their [[Star Wars: Edge of the Empire|''Edge of the Empire'']] roleplaying game.<ref name="ND" /> Though his image in the book is not explicitly labeled, the artist, [[Joel Hustak]] confirmed the identity in an Instagram post.<ref name="Instagram">{{Instagram|username=joelhustak|url=p/BQD4eQXB6Qj|name=Joel Hustak|date=2017-02-03|quote=Here is a full view of my painting of Viktor Hel the bounty hunter. This guy was a lot of fun to create with Fantasy Flight Games.}}</ref>
